Compare each incumbent with mDenseOn on identical held-out queries using the existing source-target component bootstrap; retain query-level comparisons as secondary diagnostics. launcherRepair.originalOutcome: Wrapper exit 0 with queue/admission output only; evaluator run directory and driver were absent. No relevance inference occurred.
launcherRepair.rootCause: The existing pc-heavy asynchronous setsid command did not explicitly inherit fd 0, so non-interactive Bash replaced the supplied stdin program with /dev/null. Node evaluated EOF and exited 0.
launcherRepair.fix: Preserve caller stdin with explicit fd 0 redirection at the existing asynchronous launch seam. The corrected measurement command also requires a nonempty evaluator completion receipt after the wrapper returns.

performanceOverlap.procedure: Join each retained performance sample's startedAt and latencyMs interval against the actual relevance driver start and durable task termination marker.
performanceOverlap.limitation: This establishes concurrent model work; it does not measure its latency effect. Controlled performance qualification remains open.

verification.judgeStopReasons: Every retained new judge response ended with end_turn and finite non-negative usage and cost.
verification.procedure: Verified snapshot/source/contract identity, each author reference chain and original prompt, each judge prompt and raw fingerprint. Reconstructed all questions and both chunk-vote passes using the existing parser, recomputed consensus, and required exact equality with saved votes, labels, exclusion lists and agreement. Both corpus proofs passed validateIndependentCohort.
verification.agreementDefinition: Exact equality of both aggregated relevance-key sets and ambiguity flags across all 256 authored questions; malformed abstentions cannot earn agreement. Agreement does not imply a source target was retained.
verification.balancedClasses: Every retained source target supplies all four query classes; calibration and test are separate. Exclusions remove the entire four-class target.

limitations: Memory has five accepted heldout source targets; prose has two. Empirical narrow or degenerate bootstrap intervals are not proof of population equivalence.
Identifier, paraphrase and intent classes are retained separately. Any pooled result is secondary to the per-class source estimates.

The larger full accessible source census remains unexhausted. V2 stopped on provider rate limiting and V3 stopped on a malformed ambiguous judgment. V4 completed with eight memory and two prose heldout targets after conservative exclusions; its expanded model comparisons and source-group power analysis have not run.
Cosine-only rejection margins do not establish calibrated production hybrid/entity/filter/decay negative rejection; P-004 remains pending.
This measures worker CPU native-vector relevance, not HTTP performance, GPU/boundary/reliability/answer quality or final plan acceptance.
next: Measure the six expanded relevance cells from the qualified V4 manifest, retain vectors for hybrid reuse, then perform source-group power analysis. P-005 V6 runs in the qualified frozen runtime; P-006 and P-004 remain open under the existing plan. No superiority or census-exhaustion claim is established.
